title: fix(hooks): generate version for algoliaAgent in build
body:
**Summary**

The "version" script was forgotten to be copied due to a refactor at the same time as migration from React InstantSearch Hooks to the monorepo in https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/pull/5194

**Result**

* version script added
* test for versions amended to check version.ts/js as well
* updated version file for React InstantSearch Hooks
